footer.tagline: Events, applications, teams and tournaments for university clubs, in one platform.

hero.title: All your club's events in one place.
hero.body: Application forms, team building, tournament brackets and admin approval — without Google Forms, spreadsheets or hand-drawn brackets.
hero.ctaPrimary: Sign up with your school email
hero.mockupLabel: Sample event card and tournament bracket

trust.title: Designed with the clubs of Istanbul Kent University

steps.title: Get started in three steps
steps.s1Title: Sign up with your school email
steps.s1Body: Your university email verifies you; student and alumni accounts are separated automatically.
steps.s2Title: Join your club with a code
steps.s2Body: Become a member instantly with the invite code or link shared by your club president.
steps.s3Title: Apply to events in one click
steps.s3Body: Your profile details are prefilled; the form takes seconds and you can track your status live.

features.title: Everything club work needs
features.body: One flow instead of scattered tools: from application to tournament final.
features.f1Body: Build your own form with conditional questions, capacity and an automatic waitlist.
features.f2Body: The captain shares a code and teammates join in a single step.
features.f3Body: Knockout, league and group formats — fixtures and scores advance on their own.
features.f4Body: Download applications and teams as xlsx or CSV in one click.
features.f5Body: Critical changes are approved by the university admin and every step is logged.
features.f6Body: Event texts are translated once on approval, so international students can follow along.

forClubs.title: For clubs: end the scattered chain
forClubs.body: No need for four different tools for a single event.
forClubs.a1: A ready application form on the club page
forClubs.b2: Sorting and filtering by hand in a spreadsheet
forClubs.a2: Capacity, waitlist and approval on one screen
forClubs.a3: Pick a format; bracket and fixtures are generated
forClubs.b4: Sending people to another site for results
forClubs.a4: Live scores and standings on the event page

roles.title: Everyone in their own panel
roles.body: Each role has its own color and menu, so it is always clear where you are.
roles.studentBody: Explore events, apply, build teams and follow your matches.
roles.alumniBody: Keep joining your club's events after graduation.
roles.presidentBody: Manage events, applications, staff and tournaments from one panel.
roles.adminBody: Open clubs, approve requests and oversee everything at your university.

showcase.title: Tournament showcase
showcase.body: The bracket advances as soon as a score is entered. Participants see their matches and opponents instantly.
showcase.label: Sample four-team knockout bracket

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Which email can I sign up with?
faq.a1: Your university student or alumni email (e.g. ogr.kent.edu.tr). Personal emails are not accepted, so everyone is verifiably from that university.
faq.q2: I am an alumnus — can I still join?
faq.a2: Yes. Sign up with your alumni email; if you do not have one, you can verify with a document.
faq.q3: How do I join a club?
faq.a3: Use the invite code or link shared by the club president or staff and you become a member instantly.
faq.a4: It is free for students and clubs.
faq.a5: Data is stored in line with KVKK, is visible only within your own university, and critical actions are logged.
faq.q6: My university is not listed. What should I do?
faq.a6: Enter your school email on the sign-up screen; if your university is not found you can send a request to add it.
